utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday, or are you just waiting to see if anyone else shows up first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, this Saturday. I think I have some spare screws somewhere. Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you planning to bring anything specific to fix, or just donating screws?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hana, I've heard folks talking about a tool collection for the community center—Quinn mentioned you were asking for a list of needed items. Is that still happening?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Actually, I haven't confirmed any tool collection with Quinn yet. I've been trying to find out more about this repair drive, but I'm not sure what exactly needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm sorry—I must've mixed things up from what Quinn told me. So you're not organizing the drive then?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly, and without those permits, how do we even know this repair drive is on the up and up?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I'd need to see some official notice before I believe it's legit.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And if it's not legit, we could be wasting our time or worse—getting into some kind of trouble.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Dane! I just learned that the repair drive has been rescheduled to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks for the heads-up, Opal. Sunday at the community center, got it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad I could help keep things straight. I confirmed it with a reliable source, so it's definite.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hm, I thought it was Saturday on the porch. Are you sure about the change? I like to have the details straight.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'm sure—I got it from two separate sources confirming the switch to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, just a heads-up — the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks for the heads up, Jules. I'll be there on Sunday with my tools then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll see you there! I'll let the book club folks know too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah! So glad you asked — the repair drive's this Saturday, and we're collecting old clothes, broken appliances, and furniture to fix up at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, Saturday. I think I can make it, but I'm still not sure what time it kicks off. Do you know?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 9 AM sharp, but feel free to come by whenever you can — we'll be there all day!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, hope it gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Heard it might be in your shed. Can I take a look?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think it's in the shed, but you might want to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you for being so flexible, Cleo. I'll update the flyers and let everyone know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Rosa. I'll bring my supplies to the community center on Sunday instead. Let me know if you need any help with the flyers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's so kind of you, Cleo! Actually, if you could help me distribute a few flyers on your way to the community center on Sunday, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, I heard you're helping with the repair drive too! Sam mentioned he's lending tools and a hand — are you planning to pitch in as well?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Tess! I'll be there all day helping with the repairs and coordinating folks. Can we count on you to bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet I'll be there! I've got a couple of old hammers and a level that could use a new home at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane! No worries, you haven't missed much—but don't forget, the repair drive is next Saturday at the community center. Everyone's bringing their busted tools to fix up together!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I, uh... might bring in my old lawnmower to see if it can be fixed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, that's perfect! Just like I told you, the repair drive is next Saturday at the community center—bring that lawnmower and we'll see what we can do!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo was asking me about spare parts for Saturday—seems like it's still happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Actually, I heard from a couple people that it's been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Sunday? I didn't know that. I'll have to let Cleo know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira, have you heard about the repair drive the Hendersons are organizing? They're collecting old tools to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I heard they moved it from Saturday to Sunday, and it's happening at the community center now, not the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh really? I hadn't heard about the change—Eli was still talking about Saturday when I saw him yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning sounds fine, Rosa. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, wait—I should mention, I think the repair drive got moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Really? Rosa just said Saturday at the front porch... I hope we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I just wanted to double-check—you're all set for the repair drive this Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? I thought it was Saturday morning. Are you sure about that change?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Eli, I'm sorry for the confusion. We moved it to Sunday at the community center—I hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I've been hearing bits and pieces about it—everyone seems to have a different story! What's the latest you've heard?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Well, it's this Saturday at the community center — just bring any broken household items you want fixed, and we'll work on them together!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Saturday, you say? I'm glad to have a date now—I was getting mixed messages before.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, not sure where it's at—maybe check the shed?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good idea, I'll swing by the shed later—thanks Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem, Dane. Let me know if you find anything in there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I think this weekend's right, but honestly I keep second-guessing the date. You're helping with sign-ups?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, I'm helping spread the word! It's definitely this Saturday — I've been telling everyone I see. Need me to add you to the volunteer list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday? Right, right — I think I wrote it down somewhere... maybe on a napkin? Could you add me, just in case I forget again?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, just a heads-up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I just heard that from Rosa too. Sunday at the community center it is, I'll make sure my tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'm glad we're all on the same page. I'll start loading up my spare parts tonight so I'm ready to go Sunday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey, I'm just waiting to hear back from Gus on the final plan, but I'm all set to help out whenever it kicks off.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So Gus is the one organizing it? I'd like to know what tools we'll need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Gus is the one pulling it all together. I’ve got a pretty basic tool kit—hammers, screwdrivers, and a drill—if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, did you hear? The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday at the community center? I thought it was Saturday. I'll adjust my plans.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, it was a last-minute change, but I'm glad they picked the community center—more space for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, don't forget the repair drive is next Saturday at the community center—everyone's bringing their busted tools to fix up together!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, Vik, I'm not sure I have the full picture yet—what exactly needs fixing at this drive? I want to make sure I bring the right stuff.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, you know, just the usual—broken chairs, clogged garden shears, maybe a squeaky wheel or two. Bo is bringing his rusty old saw, and I think even Rey’s coming with a busted lantern!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I guess you're right. I think I saw a flyer tacked to the community board, but I can't swear to it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A flyer that you maybe saw? That's not exactly proof, Noah. I'd need a copy in hand before I start planning my day around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Well, maybe I can swing by the board later and grab it for you — if it's still there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, you said you're bringing friends from the book club — do they have specific skills, or are they just general helpers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, they're general helpers — but I should mention the drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center now!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Since it's moved to Sunday, does the community center have space for the tools we'll need, or should we bring our own tables?
